method: At each month-end t from v1.0's first positions (2006-01) to 2019-12: v1.0's held positions after the no-trade band (em_macro.systematic.run(build_inputs(), DESIGN['signals']).attrs['weights'], frozen design, read only); carry of each held instrument at t as the algorithm defines it (build_inputs: FX = local policy rate minus fed funds, monthly averages; EM bonds = 10y yield minus local policy rate; euro spreads = the spread; DE10Y = yield minus policy rate; percentage points a year; the latest available month when t is missing); spread = equal-weighted mean carry of the long positions minus equal-weighted mean carry of the short positions, both books together. Threshold = the 10th percentile of the monthly spreads (linear interpolation, as numpy.percentile). Only month-ends to 2019-12 are used; no 2020+ value enters the threshold.
source: Frozen v1.0 code em_macro/systematic.py (tag v1.0-frozen, commit 7886867) on the repository's processed panels (data/processed/daily_panel.csv, country_month_panel.csv) and the public series it downloads (FRED DFF, DEXUSUK, DEXUSEU; BIS policy rates and CPI; Banco de la Republica TRM; Banco Central de Chile dolar observado). The S&P 500 benchmark download is stubbed (not a position input). Monthly values: results/v1_rules/carry_spread_2005_2019.csv.
